title: Add the unified serve target to a project
description: The Nx adapter of the house dev loop: a `dev-server` leaf (@angular/build:dev-server — host 0.0.0.0, configurations development (default) / production, buildTarget <app>:build — only when the project has no dev-server of its own and is an Angular app) and the `serve` target (@bespunky/nx-tools:serve — a thin wrapper over the stack-free `tools/dev/dev serve <app>`), plus the app's entry in `.bespunky/dev.json` seeded from the adapters that apply (only what it does not declare yet). Applied by the house `app` generator to every app and re-asserted by `scaffold.sh --sync`. Idempotent + self-healing.

project.description: Project to add the serve + dev-server targets to.
